member.name: T:Microsoft365DSC.Cache.CacheManager
member.summary: Provides a centralized, thread-safe cache for expensive data structures shared across PowerShell and C# layers. Loading data here avoids repeated deserialization and the boxing overhead that occurs when passing rich objects from PowerShell to C#.

member.name: P:Microsoft365DSC.Cache.CacheManager.IsSchemaLoaded
member.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the M365DSC schema has been loaded.

member.name: P:Microsoft365DSC.Cache.CacheManager.Schema
member.summary: Gets the cached schema as an of Hashtables. Returns null if the schema has not been loaded yet.

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Cache.CacheManager.LoadSchema(System.Collections.Generic.List{System.Object})
member.summary: Loads the schema from a list of objects, deserializes it into a list of trees, and caches the result. Subsequent calls are no-ops unless is true.
member.param: List of schema objects to cache.

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Cache.CacheManager.ClearSchema
member.summary: Clears the cached schema, allowing it to be reloaded on next access. Primarily useful for testing.
